title: The pinned corpus carries no over/under prices, so the total benchmark is missing
detail: The corpus has closing_total but not the two prices that would let the total market be de-vigged. The total Brier skill is therefore not scored against a market probability; only the side and moneyline are.

title: The 136-row log stores its own status field that is not a score
detail: Every row's 'st' is 'final' while 0 of 136 rows carried both scores in the field set this desk read; the audit re-derives scores from the reconciled corpus instead.

title: The no-manual-input requirement conflicts with the terms-of-service question
detail: Automated capture of official pages may not be permitted by the terms; the site therefore publishes counts and derived values read by hand-and-tool, and the automated job is scoped to this desk's own artifacts.
